dataNotes: air.json pm25 for monitored counties is the 2023-2025 annual design value at the highest site; yearly means in pm25Mean2023..2025 at that site. Cobb is an EPA-invalid design value (monitored-incomplete).

air.json pm25/ozone for other counties is the 2022 FAQSD tract mean averaged over tracts (unweighted by population). Ozone modeled value is the mean over tracts of the 4th-highest 2022 daily max 8-h, a one-year proxy for a design value.

Monitored minus FAQSD 2022 at monitored counties: PM2.5 mean -0.39 ug/m3 (range -1.27 to +0.28, n=17); ozone mean +2.7 ppb (range -3.7 to +11.6, n=18). Modeled PM2.5 above 9.0 does not show a violation.

Sumter, Douglas and Chattooga ozone use the valid 2022-2024 design value (Sumter Leslie and Chattooga Summerville have no 2025 value; Douglas 2025 incomplete). Columbia has no valid 2022-2024 or 2023-2025 design value.
no2 is the 2025 annual design value in ppb (NAAQS 53); only DeKalb and Fulton have NO2 monitors.
